Privacy Policy

This draft requires business review and confirmation before public launch.

YOUR INFORMATION

Enquiry privacy.

Information in your enquiry

The form collects the details you enter, including contact, vehicle, location and service information. The form prepares a WhatsApp URL in your browser; it does not submit to a website database. WhatsApp processes messages under its own terms and privacy policy.

Purpose and contact

Details are intended for responding to your service enquiry. Contact remapworksuk@gmail.com with privacy questions or rights requests.

Details requiring confirmation

The business must confirm its legal controller identity, postal contact, lawful basis, retention periods, processors, international transfer arrangements and rights procedure. Hosting providers may process technical access logs; provider and retention details must be confirmed.

Analytics and cookies

No analytics or advertising tracking is enabled in this preview. A consent implementation and updated policy must be reviewed before adding non-essential tracking.

For UK data-protection concerns, you may contact the Information Commissioner’s Office. This review draft is not final legal advice.
